rationale: Sandeep is building ReWorks.in, a B2B merch company, and has deep experience in developer communities from his time at Koii—exactly the audience that values developer-tools and open-source. Ayush brings strong software engineering skills across Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript, making him a potential technical collaborator or early user who understands the developer-tools space Sandeep is serving.
intro_message: Sandeep Singh, meet Ayush Garg — you're both invested in the developer-tools ecosystem, and Ayush's engineering chops could complement your B2B merch business as you scale.
